notes.title: Steam Leaderboards Added
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Undead Factory!
We have recently added Steam Leaderboard functionality.
Check out the details below!

- Steam Leaderboards will display the top 100 players with the highest in-game
Rate score.

-You can check out the leaderboards within Steam under Community > 
View Stats (in the top right tab) > Global Leaderboards

Get your Rate up and get a spot on the Leaderboards!

notes.title: Update Release Information (May 1st 2018)
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Undead Factory!
We have released an update that includes Steam Achievements and numerous fixes and tweaks.

■ Update Overview
[list]
[*]Steam Achievements added
[*]Adjusted some screen resolutions
[*]Minor bug fixes and tweaks
[/list]
_____________________________________________________________

[u]Achievements[/u]

Over 80 Steam Achievements have been added. Get your Undead to work!
The main Achievement types are outlined below:

<Main Achievement Categories>
[list]
[*]Upgrading your Research Lab
[*]Building or upgrading Resource Facilities
[*]Building or upgrading Defensive Facilities
[*]Unlocking new Units
[*]Infecting survivors
[*]Stealing VIP
[/list]
Other than the above categories there are plenty of other unique Achievements to master.  Good luck!
_____________________________________________________________

[u]Screen Resolution[/u]

Display aspect ratio 4:3 changed to 16:9.
We are planning on adding support for multiple other display resolutions in the near future.
_____________________________________________________________

■ About future updates

For the next update we are working on implementing Steam Rankings.  
With Steam Rankings players will be able to see how their Colony progress stands in relation to other players.
We are always hoping for community and player feedback to make our game better.

Thank you again for playing Undead Factory!
